# stalwart_tls_report_settings (Resource)

Configures TLS aggregate report generation. This singleton object always exists: creating the resource adopts the current server settings and destroying it only removes the resource from state.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `contact_info` (Attributes) Contact information to be included in the report (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--contact_info))
- `dkim_sign_domain` (Attributes) Which domain's DKIM signatures to use when signing the TLS aggregate report (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dkim_sign_domain))
- `from_address` (Attributes) Email address that will be used in the From header of the TLS aggregate report email (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--from_address))
- `from_name` (Attributes) Name that will be used in the From header of the TLS aggregate report email (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--from_name))
- `max_report_size` (Attributes) Maximum size of the TLS aggregate report in bytes (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--max_report_size))
- `org_name` (Attributes) Name of the organization to be included in the report (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--org_name))
- `send_frequency` (Attributes) Frequency at which the TLS aggregate reports will be sent. The options are hourly, daily, weekly, or disable to disable reporting (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--send_frequency))
- `subject` (Attributes) Subject name that will be used in the TLS aggregate report email (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subject))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-assigned identifier.
